mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 68 degrees with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, and we are under a Waning Gibbous moon.

The City of Verona has announced that road surface treatments are scheduled from August 4 through August 7, starting on Lincoln Street. Additionally, the city is offering a 100 dollar rebate program for residents who replace older toilets with high-efficiency models.

It is a big day for the community with the Remote Area Medical Clinic happening today at the high school, along with live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness and trivia on Monday at Hop Haus.
On July 26, officers responded to a hit-and-run crash near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane, where an 83-year-old driver was later cited for the incident.

Today's featured flavor is Oreo Cookie Cheesecake, though the store is currently closed and will open at 10 AM. You can also catch Kona Ice at Fireman's Park today from 1:30 PM to 3:15 PM. If you miss today's treat, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
